report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with sub-100ms durations except one 344ms outlier; traces show successful downstream calls and no errors. Metrics show zero 502s and no dependency operations. No evidence establishes a bounded root cause; operator hypothesis of a fault is contradicted by healthy telemetry.
